description: The chart illustrates the percentage point difference for various hidden layer configurations and activation functions across two models, mBERT and XLM-R. The horizontal axis lists four categories representing different hidden layer setups and activation functions: hidden:[50], linear; hidden:[], linear; hidden:[100], ReLU; and hidden:[50, 50], ReLU. The vertical axis is labeled "% point difference" and ranges from -0.2 to 0.2 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Each category is represented by a pair of bars, with light blue bars corresponding to mBERT and dark blue bars corresponding to XLM-R. The mBERT bars have values of approximately -0.15, 0.07, -0.1, and -0.18 for the respective categories, while the XLM-R bars have values of around -0.06, 0.2, -0.03, and -0.14. The bars are grouped by category, with the mBERT and XLM-R bars appearing side by side for each configuration. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars beyond their categorical grouping.
